subroles.name: Ball-playing centre-back
subroles.description: More carries, passes, receptions; less own-box share, long-pass share than others in the group.

subroles.name: Box-defending stopper
subroles.description: More own-box share, long-pass share, opponent-box share; less passes, carries than others in the group.

subroles.name: Wide centre-back (back three)
subroles.description: More distance from centre, average action depth, crosses (open play); less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.

subroles.name: Touchline progressor
subroles.description: More distance from centre, progressive passes, forward-pass share; less opponent-box share, lateral spread than others in the group.

subroles.name: Overlapping attacking full-back
subroles.description: More average action depth, final-third share, opponent-box share; less clearances (adj.), own-box share than others in the group.

subroles.name: Possession full-back
subroles.description: More carries, receptions, passes; less own-box share, forward-pass share than others in the group.

subroles.name: Conservative full-back
subroles.description: More own-box share, forward-pass share, long-pass share; less carries, receptions than others in the group.

subroles.name: Aggressive defending full-back
subroles.description: More pressures (adj.), tackles (adj.), aerial duels; less crosses (open play), passes leading to shots than others in the group.

subroles.name: Deep controller
subroles.description: More carries, passes, ball recoveries (adj.); less opponent-box share, distance from centre than others in the group.

subroles.name: Long-passing creator
subroles.description: More passes leading to shots, crosses (open play), long-pass share; less tackles (adj.), blocks (adj.) than others in the group.

subroles.name: Holding screen
subroles.description: More own-box share, clearances (adj.), forward-pass share; less average action depth, defensive action height than others in the group.

subroles.name: Progressive box-to-box
subroles.description: More receptions, progressive carries, defensive action height; less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.

subroles.name: Box-crashing midfielder
subroles.description: More opponent-box share, final-third share, average action depth; less passes, carries than others in the group.

subroles.name: Central creative playmaker
subroles.description: More passes, carries, receptions; less opponent-box share, distance from centre than others in the group.

subroles.name: Hard-working wide midfielder
subroles.description: More own-box share, clearances (adj.), forward-pass share; less average action depth, defensive action height than others in the group.

subroles.name: Inside forward / goal threat
subroles.description: More opponent-box share, final-third share, chance quality per shot; less progressive passes, passes than others in the group.

subroles.name: Dribbling winger
subroles.description: More progressive carries, take-ons attempted, crosses (open play); less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.

subroles.name: Dribbling channel-runner
subroles.description: More carries, progressive carries, take-ons attempted; less opponent-box share, aerial duels than others in the group.

subroles.name: Wide-roaming worker
subroles.description: More lateral spread, tackles (adj.), distance from centre; less average action depth, defensive action height than others in the group.

subroles.name: Penalty-box target striker
subroles.description: More opponent-box share, aerial duels, own-box share; less distance from centre, lateral spread than others in the group.

subroles.name: Mobile front-line finisher
subroles.description: More final-third share, average action depth, defensive action height; less aerial duels, fouls committed than others in the group.
